title: cohomology-stiefel-whitney-rpn widget params
description: The Stiefel-Whitney classes of real projective space RP^n, computed from the Whitney sum formula as an (n+1)-fold cup product. Because T(RP^n) (+) trivial line = (n+1) copies of the tautological line bundle (each with total class 1+a), the Whitney sum formula gives w(T RP^n) = (1+a)^{n+1} in the mod-2 cohomology ring H*(RP^n; Z/2) = Z/2[a]/(a^{n+1}), so w_i = C(n+1, i) mod 2. A slider sets n; the widget draws Pascal's triangle mod 2 (the Sierpinski pattern) up to row n+1, highlights that row and boxes its first n+1 entries (the surviving classes w_0..w_n, with the a^{n+1} entry crossed out by the truncation), and prints the total class w(T RP^n) explicitly. The readout reads off the consequences: RP^n is orientable iff w_1 = (n+1) mod 2 = 0 iff n is odd, and the total class is trivial (a necessary condition for parallelizability / stable triviality) iff n+1 is a power of 2 -- recovering that RP^1, RP^3, RP^7 are the parallelizable ones. No numeric params beyond the standard widgetId/title/hint.
